fields.panel1_dialog: I made ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini gossip in a WhatsApp group chat!
fields.panel2_dialog: The 11 espresso grinders came from my chat history, right?

narrative_summary: A user celebrates staging AI gossip, then wonders whether the fictional chat’s 11 grinders and spreadsheet were inferred from history.
rationale: Candidate 3 turns the premise into a sharper privacy-inference joke: the AIs’ oddly specific gossip may have come from the user’s chat history. Its final keyboard-spreadsheet beat escalates the suspicion cleanly within the Anakin/Padme template.
story_title: The group chat where your AI talks behind your back
place: at a robot comedian's open mic night
hat_pair: hockey goalie mask painted to look like a shocked emoji face
foam briefcase worn as a wide flat hat with a tiny combination lock on top
